column1: # mica kernel features v1
# The kernel options a board's kernel merges, by what consumes them: one row per feature, tab-separated, each
# the fragment common/kernel/fragments/<feature>.fragment. `core` is every board's; a board names the others
# its kernel merges in board.env's KERNEL_FEATURES, and common/kernel/compose-floor.sh composes core and those
# into the board's floor (the mica-required.fragment its kernel build merges, asserts after olddefconfig and
# ships in the kernel component), in the order of this table.
#   <feature>   the fragment's name
#   <requires>  comma-separated features a board naming this one names too, or -
#   <lsm>       comma-separated security modules the feature puts in CONFIG_LSM, after those of the rows
#               above it, or -; the composed floor states the list, and every board asserts it
#   <triggers>  comma-separated: what makes a product need the feature -- init:<init>, storage:<gpt|ubi> (the
#               model of the board's layout), feature:<product feature>, package:<Debian package in the
#               composed root> -- or -: a board opts in, nothing a product ships requires it
# src/boards/kernel-features.ts reads this table for the product checks (src/product/product.ts), the
# composed root (src/rootfs/build.ts) and the kernel component (src/image/kernel-package.ts).
core
storage-gpt
storage-ubi
init-systemd
netdev
selinux
firewall
containers
wireguard
dm-crypt
